retrieved_sources.title: Redis protected mode and access control
retrieved_sources.text: Redis is intended for trusted clients in trusted environments. Restrict network access and configure authentication. Disabling protected-mode removes a protective mechanism; inspect network boundaries and ACLs before concluding that unauthenticated access is possible.

retrieved_sources.title: Docker published ports and host bindings
retrieved_sources.text: Compose ports without an explicit host IP bind to all host addresses by default. Bind local research services to 127.0.0.1. A published Redis, PostgreSQL, Nginx or MinIO port is potential exposure; actual reachability depends on networking and vantage. Internal exposure is not automatically a policy violation.

retrieved_sources.title: Kubernetes service exposure types
retrieved_sources.text: NodePort publishes service ports on nodes and LoadBalancer requests an external load balancer. ClusterIP is cluster internal by default. These types indicate intended exposure, not proof of public Internet reachability or a vulnerability.
